name: Virtevo SEO Scanner
author: Virtevo

sections.description:
Virtevo SEO Scanner audits your WordPress site and gives you a clear SEO health score from 0-100, with specific actionable recommendations.

What it checks

  • HTTPS / SSL status
  • Search engine visibility (robots)
  • Site title length
  • Posts and pages missing meta descriptions
  • Images missing alt text
  • XML sitemap presence
  • Page caching
  • WooCommerce products missing descriptions (if WooCommerce is active)

How it works

  1. Install and activate
  2. Go to SEO Scanner in your WordPress admin
  3. Click Run Scan
  4. Fix the issues listed

Built by Virtevo — automation and digital consulting for small and medium businesses.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate via the Plugins menu
  3. Go to SEO Scanner in the admin sidebar
sections.faq:
Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. If WooCommerce is active it will also check your products.

Does it modify my site?

No. It only reads data — nothing is changed on your site.
